notes.title: Nightmare Paralysis - New Game Mode!
notes.notes:
[h2]Hello everyone, we know Halloween is behind us, but we have some nightmares to share as well![/h2]

[h3]Introducing [b]Nightmare Paralysis[/b], a free update available now for everyone, introduces a challenging new horde mode that will test THE GIRL’s tele-kill-netic powers to their limits.[/h3]

[previewyoutube=TZSKy7aZIGg;full][/previewyoutube]

Take on entire platoons of THE CULT’s brainwashed minions, but watch out for a new enemy that can fire back. The sniper cultist has a bullet with your name on it, and will put a premature end to your quest for vengeance if you don’t find a way to deal with them.

And if you’re wondering how THE GIRL can take on an entire horde of cultists with only one bullet, well, now she can reload: [b][i]by shooting herself.
[/i][/b]

[h3]Children of the Sun - Official soundtrack!![OST][/h3]

Now, you can take CotS tunes with you wherever you go!

Composed by the amazing Aidan Baker, 18 amazing songs will bring you even closer to the Children of the Sun world for just 4.99$

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3352450/Children_of_the_Sun_Soundtrack/

[h3]To celebrate this update and the OST launch, Children of the Sun is 40% off right now and you can save an extra 10% if you get the OST bundle.[/h3]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1309950/Children_of_the_Sun/

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/47787/Children_of_the_Sun_Soundtrack_Edition/

notes.title: Children of the Sun - Behind the Schemes
notes.notes:
Hi all, 

Devolver has put together a mini-documentary to show the making-of Children of the Sun. It covers the kind of music that fuels the creativity behind the game, how one email can land a publishing deal, and just how chill a game launch can be when the bugs don't show up to the party.

Once again, thank you for playing Children of the Sun. It will never stop being cool that so many people are interested in weird, experimental games like this. 

[previewyoutube=akktqfxGJr4;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Достаточно одного выстрела: Обзор Children of the Sun
notes.notes: Devolver Digital — настоящий алмаз в индустрии развлечений. Пока крупные издатели цепляются за безопасные проекты или очередные игры-сервисы с кучей микротранзакций, основанная в Техасе компания поддерживает инди-команды, которые зачастую приходят с совершенно безумными идеями.

notes.title: Children of the Sun is Available Now!
notes.notes:
[h2]Time to get your revenge, you just have to aim for it.[/h2]

Hey everyone!
 
I spent a few years working on this and now it comes to an end. I'm nervous. I'm excited. It feels strange. This is my first game and I'm incredibly grateful for this experience. Being able to make this game with the help of such wonderful people. Personally, just making this game already feels like a huge success.
 
A big thank you to everyone who supported me!

While this journey is about to end for me, yours is about to start. I really hope you will enjoy this experience! I'm looking forward to see you playing it and I  will read all your feedback.

Thank you so much for your time!

[previewyoutube=qmcZSftDvoA;full][/previewyoutube]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1309950/Children_of_the_Sun/

P.S. In case you missed it, and you want to know more, here's my [url=https://www.pastemagazine.com/games/children-of-the-sun/children-of-the-sun-interview-rene-rother-devolver-digital]recent interview[/url] with Paste Magazine where I talk about what it's like being a solo dev, and what inspired me to create Children of the Sun.

[spoiler]Here is a [url=https://www.childrenofthesungame.com/game-manual]small guide[/url] we made [b]*mild spoiler warning*[/b][/spoiler]

notes.title: The Date is Here, Children!
notes.notes:
[h2]Hello everyone![/h2]

Just over a month ago we have announced Children of the Sun, and the sheer ammount of feedback and people playing the demo was overwhelmingly amazing. And today with even more eagerness and joy we are happy to announce the release date of Children of the Sun.

[h3]Check this amazing trailer to find out the date, and whishlist Children of the Sun if you already didn't! [/h3]

[previewyoutube=uWmhTM12hPc;full][/previewyoutube]

P.S Go play the demo if you didn't already! 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1309950/Children_of_the_Sun/

Few words from the developer:

"Hey everyone!

It's been a few pretty fun weeks after the first announcement of the game and the release of the demo.
There were lots of really nice words and great feedback coming from you. I appreciate everyone who gave the Demo a moment of their time. Thank you very much!

So now that release date is public, I guess I finally need to actually finish the game. Ha!
I'm excited to see this thing being out in the wild. And I'm looking forward to hear what you think about it!"

notes.title: Welcome to Children of the Sun - Join Us!
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!
About 4 years ago I started working on this game and it was just a small random project like any other I was working on on the side. After one of those “what am I doing with my life” evenings I thought I might as well just give it a shot and send a mail to Devolver. I’m glad I did. Because now this Demo is out!

[previewyoutube=AqHQDRqzxlQ;full][/previewyoutube]

I feel incredibly lucky with all the support I got from everyone involved. Including everyone at Devolver, Aidan Baker, who did the audio, Nil Vendrell making the cutscene art, Stephen Cavalier editing the cutscenes and helping with the story, Maria de la Puente and Rocío Valentín helping with the level art, Brainwash Gang with their game design and art help, Juan de la Torre being a great producer and friend, and of course my wonderful girlfriend Vendy.

Thanks to all of you! It’s a cliché thing to say, but I could not have pulled it off without any of them.
I don’t expect everyone to be into this, but I hope some of you find joy in this experience. I’m looking forward to reading everyone’s feedback.

It’s been a crazy and exciting time for me working on this and I’m excited about what’s going to happen.
Thank you all very much for your time!

René | [url=https://twitter.com/primaerfunktion]@primaerfunktion[/url]
